policy: Clip only positively overlapping, same-facing, axis-aligned coplanar render faces. Preserve all collision meshes, bounds, normals and interpolated UVs. Never offset whole materials.

rules.reason: The lower dado owns the shared surface, not two competing faces.
First authored face owns overlapping dado corners.
Rail flange owns coincident sleeper-top patches.

excluded: Train/rail contact: requires moving-train construction, not a stationary hole in rails.
Opposing faces and non-axis-aligned faces are not modified.
confidence: High for measured coplanarity; live-camera verification still required. Not a missing-floor or route fix.
